title: Lamb tagine with apricots
steps: Dice the onion and mince the garlic and ginger on the cutting board.
Brown the lamb shoulder in olive oil in a heavy skillet over medium-high heat.
Saute the diced onion, garlic, and ginger in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Combine the lamb, sauteed aromatics, tomato, and apricot in the tagine.
Roast in the oven for 90 minutes until the lamb is fork-tender.
Boil water and steam the couscous for 8 minutes.
Plate the tagine over couscous and garnish with chopped cilantro and toasted almond.
